# Akshil Shah

> Independent AI Engineer & Consultant. A decade of shipping product across AI agents, voice systems, fintech, legaltech, healthtech, and edtech. Now focused on applied LLM infrastructure — building where intelligence stops being a demo and starts being a product.

Akshil Shah is based in India and works with founders, product teams, and operators on AI engineering engagements. Engagements typically blend hands-on architecture, prototype-to-production delivery, and senior engineering judgment. Available for select engagements; reach out at hi@akshil.com.

## Focus areas

- AI agents (sales, voice, vertical workflows)
- Voice AI and real-time conversational systems
- Applied LLM infrastructure (RAG, tool use, evals, observability)
- Product engineering and architecture for 0→1 and 1→10
- Cloud-native engineering on AWS / GCP

## Selected projects

- [AI Sales Agent (Goswirl)](https://www.goswirl.ai/) — Voice-first AI sales assistant; 24/7 showroom expert for ecommerce.
- [LegalWiz](https://www.legalwiz.in/) — One of India's leading legal-tech platforms for SMBs and founders.
- [Backtested.io](https://backtested.io/) — Crypto trading platform with live logging and historical strategy backtesting.
- [JRL MF Investor Console](https://www.jrlmoney.com/) — Wealth management platform for retail mutual fund investors.
- [JRL Alt Platform](https://www.jrladdha.in/) — India's broadest retail alternative-investments aggregator.
- [Livestream Shopping (Goswirl)](https://www.goswirl.live/one-to-many) — Video commerce platform for livestreams and shoppable UGC.
- [Beehively](https://beehively.com/) — K-12 SIS and school operations platform (US).
- SolutionX — Healthcare staffing platform for NHS trusts and agencies.
- ComplianceX — Automated background verification (DBS / NMC) for healthcare staffing.
- Redicine — Smart medication management with a connected pill-dispensing device.
- Altvest — Alternative investments platform for investors, fund managers, admins.

## How Akshil works

- Outcomes over output. Velocity is a means, not the metric.
- Strong opinions, weakly held — gut for direction, data for decisions.
- The customer is the only honest source of priorities.
- Build the smallest thing that proves the bet. Then scale only what earns it.
